name: Danny Roman
office: City of West Covina, Member of the City Council, 4th District

items.text: Danny Roman is a retired Los Angeles Police Department sergeant and business owner. His campaign says he served 34 years with the LAPD, including more than a decade in Internal Affairs. In his candidate statement, he says he is running to improve accountability in the city organization. He proposes publishing an infrastructure spending dashboard and streamlining business permitting and licensing. He supports community policing, neighborhood watch programs, and funding mental health crisis response partnerships.
